verdicts.why: Wikipedia X-Men '97 S1 ep 3 summary: the clone 'takes on the name Madelyne Pryor and leaves the team'; ep 5 places her at the Genosha gala. The Independent stage is sourced, so both files carry X-Men, Independent, Genosha.

XTAS 'Reunion' summary: the Savage Land Mutates are ones 'Magneto created years earlier' and who now serve a 'new master', so the past stage stands; 'Sanctuary' has Cortez betray him and Magneto destroy Asteroid M (Independent), and 'Graduation Day' has him in Genosha. In X-Men '97 S1 he takes the X-Men (ep 1), then leads Genosha (ep 5); after that he re-founds Asteroid M and fights the X-Men, and the finale only strands him with some of them in 3000 B.C., with no summary showing him rejoin the team. So dropping the villain file's last X-Men stage is right.

The fandom page on the 2012 variant shows him working for the TVA, then chasing Sylvie through a time door and dropping both of them to Lamentis (he leaves the TVA), then joining Kid Loki's Crew in the Void. At the end of S1 the TVA doesn't know him and hunts him; he works with them again only in S2. The main Loki page shows the Grandmaster sending him to hunt Thor and Hulk, and lists the Revengers and the Sakaaran Rebellion as his groups. Both proposed lists are right, with the past stages keyed to the hero file's first title.

Same groups in the same order in both files (Trish Talk on WNEX, then ZCN in S2, then ARN in S3, per the fandom affiliations and biography). The villain file covers only S2 and S3, so its Trish Talk past is keyed to its first title. Nothing to change.

Wikipedia episode summaries. IF S1 ep 7: the board ousts the Meachums. Ep 10: Joy gets the board to reinstate them. Ep 13: she confronts Harold and 'decides to leave' (the fandom page says she left New York without telling anyone and met Davos in Paris), but nothing says she gives up her place in the company. IF S2 ep 1: she 'asks for them to buy her out of the company; Rand agrees', which fandom calls a divestment package, and she later tells Ward she does not want to be tied to Rand Enterprises in any way. Leaving the city is not leaving the company. The real exit is the S2 buyout, so the last Independent is keyed to Iron Fist S2.
